messages.content: 請告訴我更多關於基督教及其歷史，直到14世紀為止。

function.name: religion_history_info
function.description: Provides comprehensive historical details about a specified religion till a specified century. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

religion.description: The name of the religion for which historical details are needed.

till_century.description: The century till which historical details are needed.

include_people.description: To include influential people related to the religion during that time period, default is False

message.content: 您想要包含在此時期內與基督教相關的有影響力人物嗎？如果不需要，我將僅提供一般歷史概述。
